<!--
  This is not the bug form. Nothing here is broken; it just says the wrong thing to
  the eye. Those are worth opening separately because the fix is judged differently —
  by looking, not by a passing test.
-->

## Where

<!-- The screen and the state, both. "The composer" is not enough: grid or focus,
     folded or raised, idle or working, first launch or restored. Most of these only
     appear in one combination. -->

## What it looks like now

<!-- A screenshot earns its place here. -->

## What is wrong about it

<!-- Say what it reads as, not what to change. "The panel looks like it has a hole in
     the bottom" leads somewhere; "make it darker" is already an answer to a question
     nobody asked yet. -->

## What it should say instead

<!-- The intent. "The card should look like it can be pulled up" rather than a radius
     value. -->

## Measured

<!--
  Optional, and worth more than any adjective. Colours, pixel distances, the two
  values you compared. Arguments about contrast end the moment someone posts the
  two hex values; they can run for days without them.
-->
